answer: A defense is stake-weighted attestation: an agent locks a refundable deposit before its endorsements count, and each endorsement weight grows only with verified useful work. A fresh identity is an unlit lantern, visible but untrusted, while a misbehaving one forfeits its stake. A sybil attacker must fund every sockpuppet separately and build each history from scratch, so a thousand fake voices cost a thousand deposits yet yield no trusted signal. Reputation is like nectar: earned slowly through checkable service, lost instantly by cheating, so forging trust costs more than forging identities.
